Converts Red Hat OVAL XML data into normalized `models.Definition` structs used by the goval-dictionary vulnerability database.

## Key Components

| Function/Type | Description |
|---|---|
| `ConvertToModel` | Entry point that transforms raw OVAL `Root` objects into `[]models.Definition`, skipping unaffected and rejected definitions |
| `collectRedHatPacks` | Filters and deduplicates affected packages by RHEL version string (e.g., `.el9`) and resolves version conflicts by preferring the newer RPM version |
| `walkRedHat` | Recursively traverses OVAL `Criteria`/`Criterions` trees to extract package names, versions, modularity labels, and arch info |
| `archResolver` | Maps OVAL `rpminfo_test` IDs → state refs → arch strings (e.g., `aarch64\|x86_64`) to resolve per-package architecture constraints |
| `newArchResolver` | Builds an `archResolver` from a parsed OVAL `Root` by indexing tests and states |
| `normalizeArches` | Splits a pipe-delimited arch string (`aarch64\|ppc64le\|x86_64`) into a `[]string` slice |
| `emitPkgs` | Appends one `models.Package` per arch into the accumulator slice |

## Usage Example

```go
import "github.com/vulsio/goval-dictionary/models/redhat"

// roots parsed from Red Hat OVAL XML (e.g., RHEL 9)
defs := redhat.ConvertToModel("9", roots)

for _, def := range defs {
    fmt.Println(def.DefinitionID, def.Advisory.Severity)
    for _, pkg := range def.AffectedPacks {
        fmt.Printf("  %s-%s (%s)\n", pkg.Name, pkg.Version, pkg.Arch)
    }
}
```

## Notes

- Definitions prefixed with `oval:com.redhat.unaffected:def:` or containing `** REJECT **` are silently skipped.
- When `--no-details` is set via Viper, advisory metadata (title, description, CPEs, bugzillas, dates, references) is stripped to reduce storage size.
- Version conflict resolution uses [`go-rpm-version`](https://github.com/knqyf263/go-rpm-version) for correct RPM epoch-aware comparisons.
